findings.title: Cleanup removes an IDP named "alias" instead of the IDPs the test created.
findings.body: The cleanup is registered as `testRealm().identityProviders().get("alias")::remove`. It always targets the literal alias `"alias"`, not `"idp-alias-" + i`. None of the 20 IDPs created in the loop are removed. Line 425 has the same bug for `idp-alias-20`. Each cleanup call also hits a provider that doesn't exist, which can fail with a 404 at teardown. The leftover IDPs and organization links stay in the test realm and can break other tests in the class that count IDPs. Pass the real alias instead, e.g. `String alias = "idp-alias-" + i; getCleanup().addCleanup(testRealm().identityProviders().get(alias)::remove);`.
